same_terminal.method: Stay airside. Follow signs to your departure gate.
same_terminal.notes: Same-terminal connections are the simplest. 45 min may be possible for short-haul to short-haul, but 60 min is the safe minimum.

T2-T3.method: Walking link between Terminal 2 and Terminal 3 (about 10 minutes via the underground walkway).
T2-T3.notes: T2 and T3 are physically very close. No transit train needed.

T2-T4.method: Take the free Heathrow transfer train (or Elizabeth line) between terminals. Allow 15-20 minutes for the transit.
T2-T4.notes: Furthest pairing. Build in plenty of buffer.

T2-T5.method: Take the free Heathrow transfer train (or Elizabeth line) between Central terminals and T5. Transit is about 5-10 minutes.
T2-T5.notes: Common BA connection if your inbound was a Star Alliance flight to T2.

T3-T4.method: Take the free Heathrow transfer train (or Elizabeth line) between Central and T4. Transit is about 10-15 minutes.

T3-T5.method: Take the free Heathrow transfer train (or Elizabeth line) between Central terminals and T5. Transit is about 5-10 minutes.
T3-T5.notes: BA codeshares often connect this way.

T4-T5.method: Take the free Heathrow transfer train (or Elizabeth line) between T4 and T5. Transit is about 5-10 minutes.
T4-T5.notes: Allow time — you'll need to clear security again at T5.

oneworld_same_terminal.notes: BA, AA, CX, IB, JL, QF, QR, AY, MH, RJ, S7, UL at same LHR terminal — e.g. BA → BA at T5.

oneworld_cross_terminal.notes: Same-alliance but different terminals (e.g. AA T3 → BA T5). Bag through-checked on single PNR.

star_alliance_T2_same.notes: LH, UA, AC, SQ, NH, OS, TK, TG, ET, SK, OZ, NZ, CA, EW within Terminal 2.

star_alliance_cross_terminal.notes: Star Alliance codeshare connecting via different terminal (e.g. LH T2 → BA T5 on Star/oneworld codeshare).

skyteam_T4_same.notes: AF, KL, DL, KE, MU, VN, GA, SV, RO, AM within Terminal 4.

skyteam_cross_terminal.notes: SkyTeam departure from a different terminal — rare since most SkyTeam at T4.

cross_alliance_same_terminal.notes: Different alliance same terminal — likely separate tickets or rare codeshare. Confirm bag rules.

cross_alliance_cross_terminal.notes: Different alliance + different terminal. Likely need to collect bag and re-check.

separate_tickets.notes: Self-connection on separate tickets — collect bag, exit landside, re-check at next airline, re-clear security. Always add buffer.

bag_rules: Same airline + single PNR: bag through-checked to final destination — stay airside.
Same alliance + single PNR with interline: usually through-checked. Confirm at first check-in.
Different airlines on separate tickets: collect bag at first arrival, exit landside, re-check at next airline's counter, re-clear security.
Self-connection (DIY ticketing): no through-check — same as separate tickets.
From outside the UK Common Travel Area connecting to a domestic UK flight (e.g. LHR → Edinburgh): bag may be tagged through but you still re-screen at next terminal.
immigration_rules: Most transit passengers staying airside do NOT need to clear UK immigration if connecting within 24 hours.
Long layover (>24h) or wanting to leave the airport: must clear UK immigration and may need a visitor or transit visa.
Direct Airside Transit Visa (DATV) is required for some nationalities even airside — check gov.uk/check-uk-visa.
Connecting to a domestic UK flight from outside the Common Travel Area: you must clear UK Border Control before continuing.
US-bound flights: no pre-clearance at LHR — clear US immigration on arrival.
general_tips: Free transfer trains (Heathrow transfer / Elizabeth line) connect all terminals airside-to-airside if you're transit-only.
If you cleared immigration on arrival you'll need to re-enter the airside zone, which means another security screening.
Heathrow's official Minimum Connection Time is the bare minimum. For peace of mind, add 30 minutes.
If your bag is checked through, you generally don't need to collect it between flights — confirm with the airline at check-in.
Fast Track at security is included with premium cabins or oneworld Emerald/Sapphire / Star Alliance Gold / SkyTeam Elite Plus.
